hints.title: Lexicographical Search Order
hints.text: Sort input values in ascending order initially so greedy selection yields the lexicographically smallest permutation.

hints.title: Decimal Length Modulo Arithmetic
hints.text: Appending a number x with length L to a running remainder rem produces (rem * 10^L + x) modulo k.

hints.title: Subset Memoization and Path Reconstruction
hints.text: Record reachable states of chosen subset masks and current remainders, then greedily reconstruct the first valid path.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.notes: Bitmask dynamic programming memoizes state tuples of visited elements and running remainder.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Direct permutation search tests N! combinations and times out.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Memoization map prevents re-exploring identical subset remainders.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Combine bitmask DP with lexicographical path reconstruction.
